title: Rolling aerobic, tired legs
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 1h40 at 142-152bpm, ~350m D+. Run the climbs at easy effort, no surges.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 1 flask Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops), 1 gel at 1h00.
GARMIN: ~110-130.
STOP RULE: HRV under 50 = 1h10.
WHY: back-to-back on tired legs is the durability VWT's last 6km needs.
